newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast crudes ease, unscathed by Tosco fire.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast crudes ease, unscathed by Tosco fire.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices eased with lower values for West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude Wednesday, while local traders saw no immediate pressure from a overnight fire at Tosco Avon's hydrocracker.
The fire-damaged unit, which makes gasoline and has a capacity of 32,000 barrels-per-day, sent California wholesale gasoline prices up about two cents a gallon Wednesday.
"It shouldn't affect near term crude runs at all, but what the implications are for crude bids (long-term) I'm not sure," a trader said.
